description: Helps you decide how to answer a discount request without giving away margin. You give the negotiation scenario, plus deal value, the discount asked, each side's leverage and who approves. You get a leverage assessment, a value based negotiation strategy, answers to common pushback and a discount approval framework. Ask whether the user has authority to approve the proposed terms.

approval_authority.description: Who has final approval on pricing

business_model.description: Optional: how you charge (software subscription, services, connectivity, per transaction, marketplace, hardware plus software, or investment management). Read from your other inputs when left out

buyer_leverage.description: Buyer leverage points (size, reference potential, etc.)

decision_timeline.description: When decision needs to be made

pricing_authority_status.description: Optional confirmed fact. Ask whether the user can approve this price or discount. Free-text role titles do not establish authority; unconfirmed authority holds commitment to terms.

value_delivered.description: Quantified value your solution delivers. Used in the value reframe, word for word; the guide adds no value figure of its own

your_leverage.description: Your leverage points (unique features, timeline, etc.)

your_sector.description: Optional: your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear.

your_solution.description: Your product/solution. Named in the guide and used, with your leverage, to read the sector and how you charge

name: pricing_negotiation_guide
title: Pricing Negotiation Guide
